import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('discovery', 'scripts/verify_caller_discovery.py')
tests = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(tests)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rejecting-discovery-') as directory:
    scripts = Path(directory) / 'scripts'
    scripts.mkdir()
    tests.CLI = scripts / 'qualify_callers.py'
    tests.CLI.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:scripts/qualify_callers.py']))
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(tests))
    raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
